notes.title: OVR Dynamic Resolution v1.3.0
notes.content:
Hey, here's a small update with mostly QOL stuff.
- Add a "Close to tray" option, closing the window to tray when closing it instead of closing the app.[img]https://i.imgur.com/OPCLFWT.png[/img]
- Support resolution changing back to dynamic when set to Auto when "External res change compatibility" is enabled
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tPccQRu.png[/img]
- Allow changing the GPU Index for VRAM monitoring (for if you have multiple GPUs)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JOg4iZd.png[/img]
- Use FPS for the resolution change thresholds and display the real target FPS (being those thresholds) instead of the HMD hz
[img]https://i.imgur.com/XO7eUAX.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pcLyAnA.png[/img]
- Display the actual resolution alongside the percentage
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FXjt4nB.png[/img]
- "Data average samples" has been removed from the settings and just defaults to 128 in code (the old default, maximum, and only value you'd want anyways)

notes.title: OVR Dynamic Resolution v1.2.0
notes.content:
Hi there! Here's a new update with the long-awaited whitelist feature!

[h3]Changes since v1.1.0[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a whitelist and renamed "disabled applications" to "blacklisted applications" in the General settings.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3ZtXniO.png[/img]
[*] Added the option "External res change compatibility", which automatically sets the resolution adjustment to manual when resolution is changed outside the app, allowing compatibility with apps such as OyasumiVR or Virtual Handheld. This setting is available in the General settings
[img]https://i.imgur.com/WYqTJaq.png[/img]
[*] Resolution is now internally calculated as a floating point number instead of an integer, only rounding when necessary, allowing better precision between resolution change iterations.
[*] The window title is now always named "OVR Dynamic resolution" and the version text is now displayed below it.
[/list]

- owo

notes.title: OVR Dynamic Resolution v1.1.0
notes.content:
Thanks for all the initial reviews and feedback, I'm glad this app is helping so many people have a smooth VR experience.
In fact, OVR Dynamic Resolution already has over 670 unique users!

[h3]Changes since v1.0.0:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added a "Manual resolution" mode, replacing the "Pause resolution" toggle, pausing the automatic resolution adjustment and giving you a slider to manually adjust it directly from the app.
[*] Reworked the tray icon, showing the window on left click.
[/list]
